subject: DecadeAI hosted pricing: monthly token buckets, peak TPS, and $/1M target
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@decade.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: hosted pricing follow-up (tokens, peaks, $/1M target)

Alex — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can put together a tailored hosted estimate: 

Summary from call:
- Primary product: conversational summarization + short-context embeddings for search.
- Expected steady-state monthly tokens: you mentioned a ballpark, want to confirm exact range for pricing.
- Burst profile: irregular spikes when batch jobs execute at end-of-day and during ingest windows.

Ask #1 — token volume: can you confirm a realistic monthly range (min / expected / max) for the next 12 months? for example: 1) baseline month, 2) expected ramp, 3) peak month.

Ask #2 — burst / peak TPS: can you confirm expected 95th/99th percentile peak QPS or TPS for generation requests (approx sustained minutes)? we need this to validate whether hosted (with burst credits) or Dedicated reserved capacity is a better fit.

Ask #3 — budget target: do you have a target $/1M tokens or monthly spend band we should optimize toward? if you have corporate procurement ceilings, sharing that helps.

Next steps from our side: once we get the three items above we’ll model three pricing options (hosted pay-as-you-go, committed monthly slab with volume discounts, and a hybrid reserved-with-burst plan) and share a simple cost sensitivity table.

Attaching: example token-profile template (feel free to populate and return).

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min call if faster.

—
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0124

Attachment: decadeai_token_profile.csv (token profile template — please fill baseline/expected/peak rows)

From: Alex Rivera <alex@decade.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 10:41:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call: hosted pricing follow-up (tokens, peaks, $/1M target)

Jasmine — thanks for the clear recap. Filling in the three asks below; I’ve attached a quick export from our telemetry (very rough) so you can see distribution by endpoint.

1) Monthly token range (next 12 months):
- Minimum (baseline / off-month): ~1.8M tokens
- Expected (most months): ~6.5M tokens
- Max (peak month, e.g., new feature rollout): ~11.2M tokens

2) Peak TPS / spike shape:
- Typical steady TPS: 40–120 TPS
- Occasional burst peaks (end-of-batch processing and rollouts): up to ~1,100 TPS for short periods (2–8 minutes), roughly 99th percentile burst.
- Average tokens per generation request: ~170 tokens (so peak token/sec math follows).

3) Budget target: procurement prefers a rough target of $20–$35 per 1M tokens for hosted + managed features; if a committed discount is available we can stretch toward the lower bound. For initial budgeting, please model a $28/1M midpoint.

Other notes: we need predictable fallbacks — if hosted latency SLOs are missed we need automatic fallback to a cheaper variant (or a queueing approach) to preserve user experience. Also open to talking Dedicated if pricing math favors it for sustained months >10M.

Attaching: decadeai_token_profile.csv (exported).

Best,
Alex Rivera
Head of Platform
DecadeAI
alex@decade.ai
Attachment: decadeai_token_profile.csv (telemetry export)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Rivera <alex@decade.ai>
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 10:58:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: DecadeAI hosted pricing follow-up — numbers from Alex (see attachment)

Forwarding Alex’s response and token-profile. Summary for pricing modeling:
- Expected 6.5M tokens/month typical, 11.2M peak month, bursts to ~1,100 TPS for a few minutes.
- Procurement target $/1M: mid $28 (range $20–$35).

Can you help with two things:
1) A hosted pricing sensitivity table that shows $/1M at multiple slabs (0–5M, 5–15M, 15M+), plus an estimated monthly bill at Alex’s expected/peak numbers.
2) Notes on how we would handle bursts at ~1,100 TPS on hosted: what are realistic latency/availability expectations, and do we recommend Dedicated for months consistently above ~10M?

I’ll loop back with Alex once we have a simple estimate.

—
Jasmine
Attachment included by Alex: decadeai_token_profile.csv

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Rivera <alex@decade.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: DecadeAI hosted pricing follow-up — numbers from Alex (see attachment)

Thanks — great data. Quick take and a conservative hosted estimate to share with DecadeAI: 

Pricing bands (hosted, per 1M tokens):
- 0–5M: $32 / 1M
- 5–15M: $25 / 1M
- 15M+: $19 / 1M

Using Alex’s numbers:
- Expected month (6.5M): 5M at $32 = $160; 1.5M at $25 = $37.50 → total ~$197.50 (~$30.38 / 1M effective)
- Peak month (11.2M): 5M @ $32 = $160; 6.2M @ $25 = $155 → total ~$315 (~$28.13 / 1M effective)

Burst handling (1,100 TPS short spikes):
- Hosted: short bursts handled via autoscaling and burst credits; 1,100 TPS for 2–8 minutes is feasible but may push 95–99th percentile latencies above our baseline SLOs. Recommend providing a documented fallback policy (auto-fallback to a 4-bit quantized variant or queued requests) and an SLA note that sustained bursts >10 minutes should be migrated to Dedicated.
- Dedicated: for sustained months consistently >10M tokens or predictable high-peak windows, Dedicated provides capacity guarantees and lower unit costs (we can model dedicated pricing separately).

Suggested next-step: share the hosted sensitivity table and an option sheet (hosted vs committed slab vs Dedicated) with a short pros/cons note. I attached a quick pricing estimate workbook with the math (pricing_estimate_DEC4521.xlsx).

If Alex is comfortable with $25-ish bands at 5–15M we can propose a 6–12 month committed slab (volume commit) that would move effective $/1M closer to $22. Include a clause for occasional burst credits in month of rollout.

—
Marissa Cole
Head of Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0199

Attachment: pricing_estimate_DEC4521.xlsx (pricing workbook, slab math and sensitivity table)
